0022600122.text: The Mavericks (1-2, 10th in the West, 4th in the Southwest and 2 games back) visit the Miami Heat (0-3, 15th in the East, 5th in the Southeast and 2 games back), who are on a three-game losing streak. Dallas is missing six players: Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain, 23.0 points per game this season), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee, 19.5 points per game this season), Santi Aldama (knee surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while no absences are listed for Miami. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and Dallas won their last meeting 118-108 in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
